text:
nora: Quick check-in after last night's outage. Need firm owners + CI/regression/test additions so this pattern (KV eviction -> router cascade) doesn't slip.

akash: Root cause short: eviction storms + aggressive fallback routing created a thrash window; p95 token latency spiked ~2.8x for ~10min and some outputs missed expected fragments. Postmortem has fixes, but no test artifacts yet.

lee: I'll take the deterministic harness to replay eviction+router-fail sequences. Plan: dockerized harness with toggles for eviction rate, router-latency, and route-down windows. CI job: `ci/regress/kv-router-replay`. ETA 5 days.

pat: I'll curate the prompt pack from incident logs and tag critical tokens vs fuzzy checks. Putting CSV in `redwood/evals/incident_kv_2026Q1.csv`. ETA 8 days.

irene: Perf will add a focused k6 profile: KV-miss biased clients + short customer burst (11k -> 2.5k over 9m). Will publish p50/p95/p99 baselines and a regression comparator. ETA 6 days.

nora: Acceptance criteria to bake into postmortem and CI:
- prompt pack: >=99% pass on critical tokens;
- perf: p95 token latency <= 205ms on baseline infra for KV-miss profile;
- harness: reproduce failure sequence locally <8m and fail CI on regression.

akash: Also add observability gating: alert if "prefix_eviction_rate" > threshold for 45s and a router heartbeat missing for >30s.

lee: I'll add smoke asserts to the harness to make CI fail fast. Will open GH issue `infra/regress#2026` and tag reviewers @nora @akash.

pat: Sample CSV row I'll include: `inc_id,input,expected_tokens,severity,log_ref`
`2026-03-23-05,"What changed in billing","billing,prorate",high,log-5129`
I'll add matching rules in the README.

irene: k6 sketch (placeholder):
```js
export default function(){http.post('/v1/generate',payload);sleep(0.02);}
```
I'll post perf graphs in the PR.

runbook-bot: Tabletop drill scheduled 2026-04-08 11:00 UTC. Invitees: @eng-ml, @eng-sre.

nora: Owners: LEE (harness), PAT (prompt pack), IRENE (perf). Drop PR/issue links here when created; I'll update the remediation board and schedule a 1-week follow-up.

lee: Issue + initial PR in 36h.

pat: Prompt pack PR by Tue EoD.

irene: Perf PR in 6 days.

nora: Thanks all. Closing thread; will repost board link after I collect PRs. :white_check_mark:
